outlook.statement: The management is undertaking a detailed review of its business operations with a view to rationalising costs, improving capacity utilisation and concentrating resources on commercially viable and profitable business opportunities.

The Management believes that the Indian power-tools market continues to offer long-term opportunities because of infrastructure development, industrialization, growth in repair and maintenance activity and increasing adoption of power tools by professional as well as semi-professional users. However, the Company's near-term focus is expected to remain on rebuilding sales, rationalizing the product mix, controlling operating costs and improving working-capital discipline.

Following the termination of the HYUNDAI trademark arrangement in April 2025, the Company has an opportunity to reassess its product and branding strategy. A more focused portfolio, disciplined procurement, stronger customer engagement, effective after-sales support and selective use of digital distribution can support the Company's efforts to improve competitiveness.

The management of the Company is very optimistic regarding performance of the Company in future and are taking effective steps to improve the performance of the Company through growth in revenue, managing cost, strategic marketing, increasing brand awareness and brand equity through advertisement campaign.
